root_cause: Medicare Part B 365-day statutory timely filing limit exceeded.
remediation_strategy: Clearinghouse EDI 277CA/999 Acceptance Audit & Medicare Redetermination Appeal
payer_specific_guidance: Medicare Part B strictly enforces a 1-calendar year (365 day) filing limit from Date of Service. Exceptions: Administrative error by CMS/MAC, retroactive Medicare entitlement, or retroactive cessation of Medicare Advantage.
required_evidence: Electronic clearinghouse EDI 277CA acceptance timestamp showing transmission prior to 365 days from DOS.

root_cause: Commercial payer contractual timely filing limit (typically 90-180 days) exceeded.
remediation_strategy: Clearinghouse EDI 277 Gateway Log Audit & Provider Contract Timely Filing Dispute
payer_specific_guidance: Commercial payers enforce contract-specific limits (Aetna/UHC: 90 days for non-par, 180 days for par). State Prompt Pay statutes (e.g. TX Insurance Code 1301.102) govern clean claim submission windows.
required_evidence: Clearinghouse delivery receipt or primary payer EOB date (if secondary filing).

available_actions.label: ⚖️ File State Prompt Pay Statutory Dispute

root_cause: Workers' Compensation statutory medical bill filing deadline exceeded.
remediation_strategy: Statutory Form C-4 / Medical Bill Proof of Mailing or EDI Jurisdiction Audit
payer_specific_guidance: Workers' Comp filing deadlines vary by state board (e.g. NY WCB: 90 days; CA DWC: 12 months; TX DWC: 95 days). Timely filing tolling applies when initial claim was delayed by carrier dispute.
required_evidence: Certified mail return receipt, fax confirmation log, or clearinghouse WCB electronic receipt.

available_actions.label: 📑 File State WC Board Dispute with Proof of Transmission

root_cause: Payer requires complete operative note, surgical report, or discharge summary to adjudicate procedure.
remediation_strategy: Automated EHR Clinical Records Packaging (PWK 837 Loop & FHIR Operative Record)
payer_specific_guidance: High-dollar surgical and complex spine/ortho CPTs require the signed operative record before payment is released. Transmit electronic PWK segment or upload to payer provider portal.
required_evidence: Signed operative record with surgeon signature and detailed narrative of distinct procedures.

root_cause: Itemized supply invoice, implant log, or NDC pricing sheet required for unlisted or carve-out code.
remediation_strategy: Vendor Purchase Invoice & Surgical Implant Log Packaging
payer_specific_guidance: Implantable devices, biologics (Q-codes), and unlisted instrumentation require wholesale acquisition cost (WAC) or manufacturer itemized invoice.
required_evidence: Itemized manufacturer invoice showing product number, description, and acquisition cost.

available_actions.label: 📋 Attach Itemized Vendor Invoice & Implant Log

root_cause: Service not deemed medically necessary per CMS Local Coverage Determination (LCD) or National Coverage Determination (NCD).
remediation_strategy: Evidence-Based CMS LCD/NCD Medical Necessity Packet & Conservative Therapy Trial
payer_specific_guidance: Medicare Part B MAC coverage rules require specific ICD-10 combinations, objective radiographic findings (MRI/CT), and minimum 6-12 weeks documented conservative therapy trial failure.
required_evidence: Diagnostic imaging reports (MRI/CT), physical therapy records, injection trial notes, and surgeon clinical evaluation.

available_actions.label: 📜 Generate Medicare Medical Necessity Appeal (LCD Cited)
➕ Add Covered Secondary LCD ICD-10 & Resubmit

root_cause: Service denied as experimental, investigational, or not meeting commercial clinical criteria (e.g. Milliman / InterQual).
remediation_strategy: Clinical Peer-to-Peer Review & InterQual/MCG Clinical Criteria Appeal
payer_specific_guidance: Commercial payers use MCG or InterQual clinical criteria. Attending physician peer-to-peer review with medical director within 14 days of denial is the highest-yield overturn mechanism.
required_evidence: Attending surgeon letter of medical necessity, radiographic evidence, clinical history of failed alternatives.

available_actions.label: 📜 Generate Commercial Appeal (Cite MCG / InterQual Guidelines)

root_cause: Precertification / Prior Authorization was not obtained prior to performing the service.
remediation_strategy: Retroactive Authorization Request & Emergent/Urgent Intra-Op Care Exemption
payer_specific_guidance: Prior authorization denials require evidence that the procedure was performed under emergent or urgent circumstances, or was an unexpected intra-operative extension deemed medically essential.
required_evidence: Operative note describing emergency/intra-operative findings and original authorization approval for primary procedure.

root_cause: Managed Medicaid prior authorization missing or authorization number mismatched.
remediation_strategy: State Medicaid Retroactive Prior Auth Grievance & Fair Hearing Request
payer_specific_guidance: Medicaid managed care organizations (MCOs) must adhere to state administrative grievance guidelines. In emergency cases, EPSDT or emergency stabilization overrides PA requirements.
required_evidence: Emergency department admission notes, triage score, or surgeon emergency certification.

available_actions.label: ⚡ File Medicaid MCO Retroactive Auth with Emergency Cert
⚖️ Request State Medicaid Agency Fair Hearing

root_cause: Procedure code inconsistent with modifier used or required distinct procedural modifier is missing.
remediation_strategy: CPT-Modifier Reconciliation & Distinct Procedural Service (-59 / -XS) Alignment
payer_specific_guidance: When two surgical procedures are reported on the same day, payers require Modifier -59 or X{EPSU} modifiers to establish distinct anatomical site or separate surgical session.
required_evidence: Operative note describing separate incision, separate lesion, or distinct anatomical compartment.

root_cause: Missing or inconsistent anatomical modifier indicating laterality (RT, LT, 50).
payer_specific_guidance: Procedures on paired organs, extremities, or eyes require anatomical modifiers (RT=Right, LT=Left, 50=Bilateral) to comply with payer editing rules.
required_evidence: Operative report explicitly identifying the surgical site laterality (Right vs Left).

root_cause: Benefit included in payment/allowance for another service per NCCI PTP edit (Indicator 1).
remediation_strategy: NCCI PTP Indicator 1 Overturn with Clinical Unbundling Substantiation
payer_specific_guidance: Under CMS NCCI Policy Manual Chapter 1, Indicator 1 edits are permissible with an appropriate modifier (-25, -59, -XS, -XE) when clinical documentation proves distinct encounter or separate anatomical site.
required_evidence: Operative record verbatim proof of separate anatomical compartment or separate encounter.

root_cause: Non-overridable NCCI PTP bundling edit (Indicator 0). Mutual exclusivity bars unbundling under all circumstances.
payer_specific_guidance: CMS guidelines state that Indicator 0 edits cannot be bypassed with any modifier. Submitting modifiers to bypass Indicator 0 is an OIG compliance violation. Balance must be written off contractually.

root_cause: Payer coordination of benefits indicates another payer is primary per Birthday Rule or Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) rules.
remediation_strategy: Real-Time Eligibility (RTE 270/271) Verification & Primary Payer Reroute with EOB
payer_specific_guidance: Coordination of Benefits (COB) denial. Run real-time 270/271 inquiry to verify active primary coverage. If primary has adjudicated, attach primary 835/EOB and submit secondary 837.
required_evidence: Primary Explanation of Benefits (EOB) or active eligibility verification printout.

available_actions.label: 🔁 Reroute to Primary Payer with Primary EOB

root_cause: Exact duplicate claim / service previously received and adjudicated.
remediation_strategy: Remittance Cross-Reference & Repeat Procedure Modifier (-76 / -77) Appeal
payer_specific_guidance: If service is a legitimate repeat procedure on the same day by the same physician, append Modifier -76. If by another physician, append Modifier -77. Otherwise, match against original paid voucher and close.
required_evidence: Original paid check/EFT transaction ID or clinical documentation proving two separate surgical encounters.

available_actions.label: 🔎 Match with Paid Original Claim & Reconcile
📑 Submit Appeal with Modifier -76 (Repeat Procedure by Same MD)

root_cause: Charge exceeds fee schedule / maximum allowable or contracted fee arrangement.
remediation_strategy: Contracted Fee Schedule Audit & Approved Contractual Adjustment
payer_specific_guidance: CARC 45 is a contractual write-off mandated by participating provider agreements. Audit the allowable against contracted fee schedules. If underpaid relative to contracted rate, file underpayment appeal.
required_evidence: Provider contract fee schedule exhibit or Medicare RBRVS conversion factor.

available_actions.label: 💰 File Underpayment Dispute vs Contracted Fee Schedule

root_cause: Personal Injury Protection (PIP) benefit limited due to absence of Emergency Medical Condition (EMC) certification.
remediation_strategy: Emergency Medical Condition (EMC) Statutory Certification Packaging
payer_specific_guidance: Under state PIP statutes (e.g. Florida F.S. 627.736), failure to submit a physician-certified Emergency Medical Condition (EMC) limits benefits from $10,000 to $2,500. Submit licensed physician EMC statement.
required_evidence: Attending physician EMC written certification declaring acute symptoms endangering patient health.

available_actions.label: 📋 Attach Physician Emergency Medical Condition (EMC) Cert
⚖️ Issue Formal Statutory Pre-Suit Demand Letter
